name: ReVeil
summary:
Your wedding day passes in a blur. ReVeil lets you go back.

ReVeil transforms the films from your wedding into a private, immersive estate — a place in VR where your day lives on. Cinematic 360° films put you back inside each moment, right where it happened: beside the altar for the vows, in the middle of the tent for the father-daughter dance, in the library while the toasts are told.
